signOffConditionVerdicts.note: The classification is a field of the reported value, set where the value enters the station and immutable afterwards. No screen carries it, no global simulation singleton exists and no display queries a mode. A screen cannot render the value without the classification because they are one object, so the property holds structurally rather than by convention.

guardPermissions.reason: The flag has a settled location on the reported value and a settled route to every display, so a simulated-source identifier may appear in the tree. It is permitted on the reported value and on the link configuration, and not on a screen.

settled.element: the location of the simulated-source flag on a reported value

entries.value: A field of the reported value itself, beside its observation class, carrying a four-member provenance enumeration: Unattributed, Live, Simulated, Replayed. It is set once where the value enters the station, from the link that delivered it, and is immutable thereafter. Unattributed is the default so that a value nobody attributed never claims to be real, which follows AeroraMissionIndex::Origin, where a sequence number whose provenance is unrecorded is Unattributed and carries no number. Replayed is a member rather than a kind of Simulated, so the three ways a value can fail to be live stay distinguishable.

settled.element: the means by which the flag reaches each display that shows the value

entries.value: It travels inside the value, not beside it. This is the recorded Aerora precedent: AeroraLinkProfile carries the profile revision inside AeroraDerivedLinkFigure because the two are read together and a value separated from its provenance is one a reader assumes is current. There is therefore no separate signal, no screen-level property, no global mode singleton and no parallel channel that could arrive late or not at all. A display binds to the value and gets the classification with it.
